about: Outpost's curated lists for the first-run wizard: Wikipedia sizes, and topics in three levels where each level includes the ones before it. Books are Kiwix catalog names plus flavour ("" when the catalog lists none). Sizes always come from the live catalog; entries it no longer has are dropped. Check with: npx tsx scripts/check-collections.ts
